_note: 献精室's attributes of a play (#115 §4; the scoring's source of truth - not the play summaries' prose): a weak spot is a combo of a part (part: the play's category, data/play_categories.json, mapped by parts) and a lead (who drives the motion: giver - the side that serves / puts in, receiver - the side served / taken; the app reads it as her / him by the group's giver, data/plays.json groups). Worked out in this order: the group's rules (its categories to parts - a category not listed is left out; the lead by default, receiver for a name with a word of receiver_words or a category of receiver_categories), then overrides by the play's id ({part, lead}, or null to leave it out), then what is left out - a name with a word of exclude_words, a name with the words of two categories (mixed: which part it is is not plain), a service play whose receiving parts lack require_receiver_part (it does not work on his penis), a play given by the player or by both (彼から, mutual: not for him). Reversed starts are never candidates (the first prototype). Mirrored into the catalog (plays' kensei) and MUSE_GUIDE_plays.md; bridge/tests/test_kensei_data.py checks them against this file.
